description: Namma Metro / BMRCL QR ticket screenshot

ticket_id.description: Unique ticket or booking reference number

order_id.description: Order or booking ID shown on screen

qr_payload.description: Raw text encoded in the QR code if visible

timestamp.description: Ticket issue date and time (ISO 8601 preferred)

status_text.description: Status label visible on screen, e.g. 'Valid', 'Used'

payer_name_masked.description: Partial / masked name of the ticket holder if shown

app_name.description: App or channel that issued the ticket, e.g. 'Namma Metro', 'WhatsApp'

language_detected.description: BCP-47 code of the primary language in the screenshot, e.g. en, kn
